note: Image pins for the installer. `digest` is the amd64 image digest. A null digest means NOT PINNED YET: the installer warns, and refuses it when require_digests is set. `status` says how far a pin is verified. Read digests again with `docker buildx imagetools inspect` before relying on them; Splunk and Ollama tags are re-pushed.
